cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before slowing, turning or changing … can be made safely.”
cards.back: Before slowing, turning or changing lanes, check that the movement can be made safely.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Use a signal to tell … pedestrians your intended movement.”
cards.back: Use a signal to tell drivers, cyclists and pedestrians your intended movement.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Give the required signal at … the movement or turn.”
cards.back: Give the required signal at least one hundred feet before the movement or turn.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Keep a turn signal operating … are ready to turn.”
cards.back: Keep a turn signal operating until you are ready to turn.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A vehicle required to have … to indicate a turn.”
cards.back: A vehicle required to have electric turn signals must use them to indicate a turn.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At a stop sign, stop … when one is present.”
cards.back: At a stop sign, stop at the marked stop line when one is present.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At a stop sign with … nearest the intersecting roadway.”
cards.back: At a stop sign with no stop line, stop before the near-side crosswalk; if there is no crosswalk, stop nearest the intersecting roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop when leaving an alley, … residential or business area.”
cards.back: Stop when leaving an alley, private drive or building in a residential or business area.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop when a school crossing … in the stop position.”
cards.back: Stop when a school crossing guard holds the official flag in the stop position.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop when directed by a … flagger or control device.”
cards.back: Stop when directed by a railroad-crossing flagger or control device.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop when a construction flagger … you to do so.”
cards.back: Stop when a construction flagger directs you to do so.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Stop whenever a police officer … directs you to stop.”
cards.back: Stop whenever a police officer directs you to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A flashing red traffic light … requires a complete stop.”
cards.back: A flashing red traffic light requires a complete stop.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Kansas requires a driving speed … for the conditions present.”
cards.back: Kansas requires a driving speed that is reasonable for the conditions present.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Choose speed after considering road … and your physical condition.”
cards.back: Choose speed after considering road conditions, weather, the vehicle and your physical condition.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The listed normal-condition maximums do … speed for special hazards.”
cards.back: The listed normal-condition maximums do not remove the need to reduce speed for special hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Unless a different limit is … thirty miles per hour.”
cards.back: Unless a different limit is posted, an urban district has a maximum speed of thirty miles per hour.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Outside towns, the maximum is … different limit is posted.”
cards.back: Outside towns, the maximum is seventy-five miles per hour on a separated multilane highway designated and posted by the Secretary of Transportation, unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Outside towns, a state or … different limit is posted.”
cards.back: Outside towns, a state or federal highway has a maximum speed of sixty-five miles per hour unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Outside towns, a county or … different limit is posted.”
cards.back: Outside towns, a county or township road has a maximum speed of fifty-five miles per hour unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A properly marked school zone … maximum unless posted otherwise.”
cards.back: A properly marked school zone has a twenty-mile-per-hour maximum unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A properly marked business district … maximum unless posted otherwise.”
cards.back: A properly marked business district has a twenty-mile-per-hour maximum unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A school bus follows the … school-district policy determines otherwise.”
cards.back: A school bus follows the posted speed limit unless school-district policy determines otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Driving below a posted minimum … weather and traffic conditions.”
cards.back: Driving below a posted minimum is unlawful under normal road, weather and traffic conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Unnecessarily slow driving that blocks … without a posted minimum.”
cards.back: Unnecessarily slow driving that blocks normal traffic is unlawful even without a posted minimum.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A slower speed remains permissible … speed rule requires it.”
cards.back: A slower speed remains permissible when safe operation under the basic speed rule requires it.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Kansas requires passenger-vehicle occupants to …”.
cards.back: Kansas requires passenger-vehicle occupants to use safety restraints.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “An officer may stop a … in a front seat.”
cards.back: An officer may stop a vehicle solely for seeing an unbelted adult in a front seat.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “An officer may stop a … in any seating position.”
cards.back: An officer may stop a vehicle solely for seeing an unrestrained child in any seating position.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The passenger-car driver must ensure … by an appropriate restraint.”
cards.back: The passenger-car driver must ensure that every child in the car is properly protected by an appropriate restraint.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The cited restraint rule defines … fewer than ten passengers.”
cards.back: The cited restraint rule defines a passenger car as a vehicle built for fewer than ten passengers.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Children younger than four must … approved child safety seat.”
cards.back: Children younger than four must ride in a federally approved child safety seat.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook requires a seat … aged eight or older.”
cards.back: The handbook requires a seat belt for children aged eight or older.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook identifies the center … the safest safety-seat location.”
cards.back: The handbook identifies the center position in the rear seat as the safest safety-seat location.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Install and use a child … to its manufacturer's instructions.”
cards.back: Install and use a child safety seat according to its manufacturer's instructions.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before turning right from a … the right lane early.”
cards.back: Before turning right from a divided four-lane highway, move into the right lane early.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When turning right from a … cross street's right lane.”
cards.back: When turning right from a four-lane divided highway, make a tight turn into the cross street's right lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “For a left turn on … center line or divider.”
cards.back: For a left turn on a multilane road, begin in the inside lane near the center line or divider.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When turning left from a … line without swinging wide.”
cards.back: When turning left from a multilane road, enter just right of the cross street's center line without swinging wide.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Signs or pavement arrows may … turns from multiple lanes.”
cards.back: Signs or pavement arrows may authorize turns from multiple lanes.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not make a U-turn … or near a hilltop.”
cards.back: Do not make a U-turn on a curve or near a hilltop.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A U-turn is prohibited where … five hundred feet away.”
cards.back: A U-turn is prohibited where other drivers cannot see your vehicle from at least five hundred feet away.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Follow local ordinances and regulatory …”.
cards.back: Follow local ordinances and regulatory signs controlling U-turns.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “A left-turning driver yields …”.
cards.back: A left-turning driver yields to oncoming traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When a left-turning vehicle and … straight-moving vehicle has priority.”
cards.back: When a left-turning vehicle and a straight-moving vehicle enter together, the straight-moving vehicle has priority.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “On a two-way road with … with the speed limit.”
cards.back: On a two-way road with two lanes, a left-side pass requires a safe gap and compliance with the speed limit.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before passing, check ahead for … driver beginning to pass.”
cards.back: Before passing, check ahead for room and behind for another driver beginning to pass.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Use the left-turn signal before … pass on the left.”
cards.back: Use the left-turn signal before beginning a pass on the left.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “After passing, signal right before … to your normal lane.”
cards.back: After passing, signal right before returning to your normal lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Return right after a pass … in your inside mirror.”
cards.back: Return right after a pass only when the entire front of the passed vehicle appears in your inside mirror.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When another vehicle passes you, … your lane without accelerating.”
cards.back: When another vehicle passes you, stay in your lane without accelerating.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Do not pass where a …”.
cards.back: Do not pass where a sign forbids it.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The pennant-shaped warning sign marks … from the left roadside.”
cards.back: The pennant-shaped warning sign marks the start of a no-passing area from the left roadside.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Double solid yellow center lines … direction from crossing them.”
cards.back: Double solid yellow center lines prohibit traffic from either direction from crossing them.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Finish a pass and return … within two hundred feet.”
cards.back: Finish a pass and return to your lane before an oncoming vehicle is within two hundred feet.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook identifies the no-passing … only pennant-shaped warning sign.”
cards.back: The handbook identifies the no-passing warning sign as the only pennant-shaped warning sign.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Passing on the right is … in the same direction.”
cards.back: Passing on the right is permitted on a one-way road marked with at least two lanes traveling in the same direction.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not use the shoulder … instructions from traffic authorities.”
cards.back: Do not use the shoulder to pass except for an emergency or instructions from traffic authorities.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Check ahead and behind and … passing on the right.”
cards.back: Check ahead and behind and signal before passing on the right.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Following distance must be reasonable … roadway and traffic conditions.”
cards.back: Following distance must be reasonable for weather, roadway and traffic conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Leave enough following space to … vehicle ahead stops abruptly.”
cards.back: Leave enough following space to stop or turn if the vehicle ahead stops abruptly.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook uses a two-second … interval for ideal conditions.”
cards.back: The handbook uses a two-second following interval for ideal conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook uses a four-second … when conditions are adverse.”
cards.back: The handbook uses a four-second following interval when conditions are adverse.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Increase the following gap behind … frequently or turn abruptly.”
cards.back: Increase the following gap behind vehicles likely to stop frequently or turn abruptly.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Poor weather calls for an … even greater following gap.”
cards.back: Poor weather calls for an even greater following gap.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Following too closely limits the … and road conditions ahead.”
cards.back: Following too closely limits the view of traffic and road conditions ahead.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

decks.module: Buses, emergency vehicles and road workers

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “For an approaching emergency vehicle … stop clear of intersections.”
cards.back: For an approaching emergency vehicle using flashing red lights or a siren, pull right and stop clear of intersections.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Unless on the opposing roadway … unload children must stop.”
cards.back: Unless on the opposing roadway of a divided highway, a driver meeting or overtaking a school, church or day-care bus stopped to load or unload children must stop.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “After stopping for a school, … red lights turn off.”
cards.back: After stopping for a school, church or day-care bus loading or unloading children, remain stopped until its stop signal retracts and red lights turn off.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Traffic on the opposing roadway … loading or unloading children.”
cards.back: Traffic on the opposing roadway of a divided highway need not stop for a school bus loading or unloading children.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “An emergency vehicle using a … or bell has priority.”
cards.back: An emergency vehicle using a forward red light or a siren or bell has priority.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “For an emergency vehicle using … until it has passed.”
cards.back: For an emergency vehicle using a forward red light, siren or bell, pull right and remain stopped until it has passed.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not follow an emergency … responding with warning signals.”
cards.back: Do not follow an emergency vehicle responding with warning signals.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When approaching a stopped emergency … lane change is possible.”
cards.back: When approaching a stopped emergency vehicle using flashing warning lights from behind on a road with at least two lanes in each direction, cautiously move out of its adjacent lane if a lane change is possible.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “If a lane change is … down and proceed cautiously.”
cards.back: If a lane change is impossible when approaching from behind a stopped emergency vehicle using flashing warning lights on a road with at least two lanes each way, slow down and proceed cautiously.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Yield to construction workers and … working on the road.”
cards.back: Yield to construction workers and vehicles actively working on the road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Move to a lane away … working on the roadway.”
cards.back: Move to a lane away from a construction vehicle working on the roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

decks.module: Intersection priority and available exit space

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Yield to a vehicle that … intersection from another road.”
cards.back: Yield to a vehicle that has already entered the intersection from another road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “When vehicles enter an intersection … driver on the right.”
cards.back: When vehicles enter an intersection from different roadways at about the same time, the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At an uncontrolled intersection, yield … vehicle on your right.”
cards.back: At an uncontrolled intersection, yield to the vehicle on your right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At a stop-controlled entrance to … without interfering with traffic.”
cards.back: At a stop-controlled entrance to a through road, stop and enter only without interfering with traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A vehicle entering from a … on the public roadway.”
cards.back: A vehicle entering from a private drive or side road yields to traffic on the public roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Before crossing the sidewalk from … stop and then yield.”
cards.back: Before crossing the sidewalk from an alley, driveway or building in a business or residential district, stop and then yield.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “At a yield sign, stop … priority traffic or pedestrians.”
cards.back: At a yield sign, stop only when needed to avoid interfering with priority traffic or pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not enter an intersection, … it for your vehicle.”
cards.back: Do not enter an intersection, crosswalk or railroad crossing without space beyond it for your vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A green signal does not … lacks room beyond it.”
cards.back: A green signal does not permit entering an intersection that lacks room beyond it.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Parking inside an …”.
cards.back: Parking inside an intersection is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Parking in an intersection …”.
cards.back: Parking in an intersection crosswalk is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park within fifteen … of a fire hydrant.”
cards.back: Do not park within fifteen feet of a fire hydrant.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park with the … inches from the curb.”
cards.back: Do not park with the vehicle more than twelve inches from the curb.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Parking in front of a …”.
cards.back: Parking in front of a driveway is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Parking on a highway bridge … elevated structure is prohibited.”
cards.back: Parking on a highway bridge or elevated structure is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Parking inside a …”.
cards.back: Parking inside a tunnel is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Do not park where official …”.
cards.back: Do not park where official signs prohibit parking.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Double parking along the curb … or roadside is prohibited.”
cards.back: Double parking along the curb or roadside is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park on a … would obstruct ordinary traffic.”
cards.back: Do not park on a narrow road where the vehicle would obstruct ordinary traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Parking on a …”.
cards.back: Parking on a sidewalk is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park within the … sign or flashing beacon.”
cards.back: Do not park within the thirty-foot approach to a roadside signal, stop sign or flashing beacon.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park between a … and the nearby curb.”
cards.back: Do not park between a safety zone and the nearby curb.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park within thirty … of a safety zone.”
cards.back: Do not park within thirty feet of the curb points opposite the ends of a safety zone.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Keep parked vehicles at least … the nearest railroad-crossing rail.”
cards.back: Keep parked vehicles at least fifty feet from the nearest railroad-crossing rail.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park within twenty … a fire-station driveway entrance.”
cards.back: Do not park within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway entrance.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “On the opposite side of … parking within seventy-five feet.”
cards.back: On the opposite side of a fire-station entrance, the handbook prohibits parking within seventy-five feet.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not park beside or … so would block traffic.”
cards.back: Do not park beside or opposite roadwork or another obstruction when doing so would block traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook lists designated disability-parking … among restricted parking locations.”
cards.back: The handbook lists designated disability-parking spaces among restricted parking locations.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Kansas prohibits composing, sending or … electronic communication while driving.”
cards.back: Kansas prohibits composing, sending or reading written electronic communication while driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “The written-communication restriction includes text …”.
cards.back: The written-communication restriction includes text messages and email.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “The handbook excludes GPS use … from its written-communication prohibition.”
cards.back: The handbook excludes GPS use and weather reports from its written-communication prohibition.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Talking or dialing on a … described in this section.”
cards.back: Talking or dialing on a cell phone is not specifically prohibited by the general rule described in this section.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “A distracting activity remains dangerous … is not specifically prohibited.”
cards.back: A distracting activity remains dangerous even when it is not specifically prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Recall the complete rule beginning “Move out of an …”.
cards.back: Move out of an aggressive driver's way.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Do not provoke an aggressive … your place in traffic.”
cards.back: Do not provoke an aggressive driver by accelerating or defending your place in traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Avoid eye contact that could … anger an aggressive driver.”
cards.back: Avoid eye contact that could further anger an aggressive driver.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: Complete this rule in full: “Ignore hostile gestures or insults … without responding in kind.”
cards.back: Ignore hostile gestures or insults without responding in kind.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.
